task_summary: Research-supported follow-up interpretation with user corrections; private source content and individual assessments excluded from this workflow archive.
workflow_version: WORKFLOW_REVIEW.md + WORKFLOW_DATABASE.md read in this chat

acceptance: Incorporate factual correction and clarified non-romantic scope.
Compare multiple explanations, distinguish evidence from imagination, and avoid unsupported personalized probability claims.
Use primary psychology research for general mechanisms and provide practical consensual guidance.
completed: Accepted correction and withdrew prior doubtful detail from current interpretation.
Requested specific examples asynchronously and incorporated the actual user reply.
Checked conditional wording and context in local records.
Read one independent hypothesis review and primary research on disclosure, responsiveness, closeness and interpersonal inference.
Prepared guidance distinguishing subjective closeness, factual knowledge and observed reliability.

metrics.name: Observed analysis interval
metrics.basis: First captured clock 23:35:05 to 23:38:31 +08:00; not full task time and excludes later archive.

metrics.name: Native reviewers
metrics.basis: One new actual read-only independent review returned.

metrics.name: Coordination wait
metrics.basis: Research continued while user clarification and review were pending; no isolated wait measurement.

metrics.name: Rework count
metrics.basis: Clarifications changed interpretation; no formal repeated acceptance trials.

metrics.name: Review and archive overhead
metrics.basis: Review partly interleaved; archival work follows measurement cutoff.

observations: Specific user examples materially clarified the question; generic inconsistency analysis alone missed the intended distinction between sincerity and effortful presentation.
Context check recovered a conditional qualifier omitted in paraphrase, changing interpretation of the alleged logical claim.
Comparing hypotheses improves explicit uncertainty but does not create new evidence about a person.
Public searches contained only general research topics; private record, identity and assessments were not sent to search or archived.
No matched baseline supports a speedup claim.

recommendations.action: When a user flags contradictions, obtain specific examples and verify conditionals, speaker and domain before interpreting motives; update prior claims after corrections.
recommendations.next_check: Future text analysis should explicitly separate direct evidence, competing interpretation and unknowns after each material correction.

evidence: Local source context checks and actual asynchronous user clarification.
One received read-only reviewer response with four alternative explanations.
limits: Population-level findings do not establish an individual's motives, diagnosis or truthfulness.
No independent verification of personal history or future conduct.
Research summary is not a clinical assessment.
Archive verification occurs after the measurement cutoff.
